## HDInsight  
  
<!--97355d8e-59ae-43ff-9214-d4acf728467a_begin-->

#### Upgrade your HDInsight cluster images
  
Your HDInsight cluster runs an older image, so it misses the latest open-source or other security updates, and Azure updates. Upgrade to the latest HDInsight image to keep features current. New images release every 90 days.
  
**Potential benefits**: Get the latest fixes and features.

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Before you start with Azure HDInsight](/azure/hdinsight/hdinsight-overview-before-you-start#keep-your-clusters-up-to-date).  

ResourceType: microsoft.hdinsight/clusters
